notes.title: 🖤 A sequel is out — GIRL.EXE.EXE
notes.notes:
[p]The story continues in [b]GIRL.EXE.EXE[/b] — a new game about memory, bugs, and someone who’s still inside your head
Now it’s a full journey through the five stages of grief
With errors, repeating rooms, a little dog, and her[/p][p]If you played the original GIRL.EXE — you’ll definitely want to see what comes next
And if you didn’t — now’s the perfect time to start[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3590890/GIRLEXEEXE/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]GIRL.EXE.EXE is available now on Steam [/p][p]Thanks for being here all this time[/p]

notes.title: Winter Has Come To Ublin Federation
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! [b]Dymchick1 [/b]is here. 

Our team made a [b]winter update[/b]. Yyyaay! 
Snow on the streets and a Christmas Tree are waiting you!

If you find bugs then go to our Discord [url=https://discord.gg/Jv5pdrK]https://discord.gg/Jv5pdrK[/url] and ping me Dymchick1 or Oxy949.

This year was a really difficult for everyone, including us. We hope next year will be happier, brighter and self-isolation in real live will be finished. 

Look forward to new updates and games in [b]2021[/b]!

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Save System And Achievements
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, [b]Dymchick1[/b] is here! 

I'm happy to announce:

[h2]FIRST BIG GAME UPDATE[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Save system [/b]
You can save your game progress. This is a new feature so the bugs are possible. Tell us your experience! 
[*][b]Achievements[/b]
They are finally fixed. We plan to add more achievements in the future. 
[*][b]A lot of bug fixes [/b]
Thanks to all users who sent us found bugs! If you find more then go to our Discord [url=https://discord.gg/Jv5pdrK]https://discord.gg/Jv5pdrK[/url] and ping me [b](Dymchick1)[/b] or [b]Oxy949[/b].

Have a nice day!

notes.title: Self-Isolation Has Been Released
notes.notes:
Hi, Dymchick1 is here! 

Finally, Self-Isolation begins! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37574347/90dcfbdd9efcc2844e25386e3f8129e11b19b357.jpg[/img]

This game is a simulation of self-isolation. You need to support your family, not to lose your job and finally not to go crazy. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1298530/SelfIsolation/

We still improve our game. If you find a bug in the game or translation, then go to our discord server and write to us. Also we will be grateful for translation into other languages. Our team responds as soon as possible. 

Join our Discord Server. https://discord.gg/Jv5pdrK 

Have a nice day!
